verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the YubiKey lineup's connector options (USB-C vs USB-A) or its form factors (keychain vs nano). The only nearby items are a generic mention of 'USB and NFC-enabled YubiKeys' in an SDK context and a community remark that Yubico hardware is compact, and neither establishes the specific ports and carry styles this story asks about.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors
